hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault and output tokens withdrawn from another, with pricing verified against an internal bonding curve (EulerSwap v1). Native Uniswap v4 liquidity positions are blocked; each instance is deployed as a per-pool delegatecall proxy.
